audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua east-Jordan tribes' release and altar-dispute de-escalation narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Transjordan tribes' fulfilled obligation, blessing and return, large altar at Geliloth, western war mobilization, Phinehas delegation, Peor/Achan memories, land/altar anxiety, witness-altar explanation, successful de-escalation, and naming of the altar.

verses.restored: Then Joshua called Reubenites, Gadites, and half tribe of Manasseh.

familiar.text: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.restored: He said to them, You have kept all that Moses servant of YHWH commanded you, and you have listened to my voice in all I commanded you.

familiar.text: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

verses.restored: You have not abandoned your brothers these many days to this day, and you have kept charge of command of YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.

verses.restored: Now YHWH your Divine has given rest to your brothers as he spoke to them; now turn and go for yourselves to your tents, to land of your possession that Moses servant of YHWH gave you across Jordan.

familiar.text: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.

verses.restored: Only be very careful to do command and Torah that Moses servant of YHWH commanded you: to love YHWH your Divine, walk in all his ways, keep his commands, cling to him, and serve him with all your heart and all your soul/life.

familiar.text: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.restored: Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their tents.

familiar.text: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

verses.restored: To half tribe of Manasseh Moses had given in Bashan, and to its other half Joshua gave with their brothers across Jordan westward. When Joshua sent them to their tents, he blessed them,

familiar.text: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

verses.restored: and spoke to them, saying, Return to your tents with much wealth, very many livestock, silver, gold, bronze, iron, and very many garments; divide spoil of your enemies with your brothers.

familiar.text: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

verses.restored: Sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and half tribe of Manasseh returned and went from children of Israel at Shiloh in land of Canaan to land of Gilead, land of their possession, in which they had been possessed according to mouth of YHWH by hand of Moses.

familiar.text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.restored: They came to districts of Jordan that are in land of Canaan, and sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, an altar great in appearance.

familiar.text: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

verses.restored: Children of Israel heard, saying, Look, sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and half tribe of Manasseh built altar opposite land of Canaan, in districts of Jordan, across from children of Israel.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

verses.restored: When children of Israel heard, all congregation of children of Israel assembled at Shiloh to go up against them for war.

familiar.text: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

verses.restored: Children of Israel sent to sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and half tribe of Manasseh, to land of Gilead, Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest,

familiar.text: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

verses.restored: and ten leaders with him, one leader from fathers' house for each tribe of Israel; each one was head of house of their fathers among thousands of Israel.

familiar.text: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

verses.restored: They came to sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and half tribe of Manasseh in land of Gilead and spoke with them, saying,

familiar.text: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

verses.restored: Thus says all congregation of YHWH: What is this unfaithfulness that you have acted against Divine of Israel, turning today from after YHWH, by building for yourselves an altar, to rebel today against YHWH?

familiar.text: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?

verses.restored: Is iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, though plague came upon congregation of YHWH,

familiar.text: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,

verses.restored: that you turn today from after YHWH? It shall be, if you rebel today against YHWH, tomorrow he will be angry with all congregation of Israel.

familiar.text: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

verses.restored: But if land of your possession is unclean, cross over to land of possession of YHWH, where tabernacle of YHWH dwells, and take possession in our midst; only do not rebel against YHWH and do not rebel against us by building for yourselves altar besides altar of YHWH our Divine.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD’s tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.

verses.restored: Did not Achan son of Zerah act unfaithfully concerning devoted thing, and wrath came upon all congregation of Israel? He did not perish alone in his iniquity.

familiar.text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

verses.restored: Then sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and half tribe of Manasseh answered and spoke to heads of thousands of Israel:

familiar.text: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

verses.restored: Divine of divines, YHWH, Divine of divines, YHWH, he knows, and Israel shall know: if in rebellion or if in unfaithfulness against YHWH, do not save us this day!

familiar.text: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)

verses.restored: If we built for ourselves an altar to turn from after YHWH, or to offer upon it burnt offering or grain offering, or to make upon it sacrifices of well-being, YHWH himself shall seek it out.

familiar.text: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;

verses.restored: But truly from concern, from a thing, we did this, saying, Tomorrow your children may say to our children, What is there to you and to YHWH Divine of Israel?

familiar.text: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?

verses.restored: For YHWH has placed Jordan as border between us and you, sons of Reuben and sons of Gad; you have no portion in YHWH. So your children might make our children cease from fearing/revering YHWH.

familiar.text: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

verses.restored: So we said, Let us now build for ourselves an altar—not for burnt offering and not for sacrifice,

familiar.text: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

verses.restored: but to be witness between us and you and between our generations after us, that we may perform service of YHWH before him with our burnt offerings, sacrifices, and well-being offerings, and your children shall not say tomorrow to our children, You have no portion in YHWH.

familiar.text: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.

verses.restored: We said, It shall be, if they say thus to us and to our generations tomorrow, then we shall say, See pattern/copy of altar of YHWH that our fathers made, not for burnt offering and not for sacrifice, but witness between us and you.

familiar.text: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

verses.restored: Far be it from us to rebel against YHWH and turn today from after YHWH by building altar for burnt offering, grain offering, or sacrifice, besides altar of YHWH our Divine that is before his tabernacle.

familiar.text: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.

verses.restored: When Phinehas the priest and leaders of congregation, heads of thousands of Israel who were with him, heard words sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and sons of Manasseh spoke, it was good in their eyes.

familiar.text: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

verses.restored: Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest said to sons of Reuben, sons of Gad, and sons of Manasseh, Today we know YHWH is in our midst, because you have not acted this unfaithfulness against YHWH; now you have rescued children of Israel from hand of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.

verses.restored: Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest and leaders returned from sons of Reuben and sons of Gad, from land of Gilead to land of Canaan, to children of Israel, and brought back word to them.

familiar.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

verses.restored: The word was good in eyes of children of Israel, and children of Israel blessed Divine and did not speak of going up against them for war, to destroy land where sons of Reuben and sons of Gad dwelt.

familiar.text: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

verses.restored: Sons of Reuben and sons of Gad called altar Witness, for it is witness between us that YHWH is Divine.

familiar.text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.

translation_notes: The east-Jordan tribes fulfill their military obligation and are released with blessing, wealth, and a renewed charge to love, walk, keep, cling, and serve.
The altar crisis shows how quickly religious anxiety and inherited trauma can mobilize a community toward civil war.
The western tribes choose delegation before attack, sending Phinehas and ten leaders to investigate. This procedural pause prevents bloodshed.
The accusations invoke Peor and Achan, memories of corporate catastrophe that could have escalated panic and collective punishment.
The east-Jordan explanation is about future belonging: they fear the Jordan border will let later generations say, 'You have no portion in YHWH.'
The altar is not a rival sacrificial site but a witness/copy that protects covenant inclusion across geography.
The chapter is one of Joshua's strongest de-escalation narratives: accusation is heard, explanation is accepted, war is stopped, and the altar becomes testimony rather than rebellion.
This successful outcome must not erase the threat of destruction that nearly arose from religious misunderstanding.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 22 to justify religious vigilantism, preemptive war, civil conflict, or collective punishment based on suspected impurity. Center investigation before action, listening to feared minorities, honoring geographic diversity within shared covenant, and accepting explanations that prevent violence.
